_comment: Job template for phone-recorded creator content. Source is expected to be 9:16 vertical (phone in portrait). The pipeline auto-detects this and skips the streamer-overlay composite + ESRGAN/GFPGAN steps because the source is already a clean full-frame shot. Output is 9:16 only (matches source). Three style variants, each color-graded, ~1-2 min total render time per clip.
